name: EHWA's Sundays Sacrifical Slam

date.source: The document's own opening line, billing itself "THIS WAS A RECENT CARD HELD."

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
matches.finish: Maverick retains the Extreme Television Championship over the Playboy, submission (sharpshooter).

notes: Also carries an opening tag match (billed beforehand as "the new tag champions defend their titles") between an unnamed challenging team and a team the text calls "The Masters of the Apocalypse," won by the latter -- the participants' own team assignments (four names given: Martin, Jean, Fear, Pain) are not clearly resolved by the surviving text and this match is not structured into the World Tag Team Championship's own reign record. A non-title match between Ivan Thor Thunder (billed holding "his Internet championship") and Maverick ("as far as I'm concerned this is for the titles... some piece of trash... said its not") is won by Maverick. A three-way dance among Agony, Vengence and Eclipse (with Pain and Cataclysm interfering) is won by Agony.

name: EHWA Pay-Per-View, 4 March 1997

date.source: The document's own dateline, "Here is the recent pay per view matches for the Extreme Hardcore Wrestling Assocation."

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-tag
matches.finish: The Knights (Darknight & Midnight) retain by disqualification over the Doggpound (Doggystyle & Kurupt), after Darknight throws Kurupt onto the referee; the title does not change hands on a disqualification.

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
matches.finish: Viglen wins the Extreme Television Championship from Maverick with a chair shot Maverick's own fan hands him, then a dropkick and a cover.
Ivan Thor Thunder defeats Bloodhound by bearhug submission.
Justin Blaze defeats Hades with a belly-to-belly suplex.

notes: Also carries an opening match (Buddah Lova defeats a newcomer, Psycothic, by pinfall after a sleeper reversal), a debut match (Red Panther defeats Westside Gangsta by pinfall after a brainbuster and top-rope leg drop), and the last leg of an Internet Tag Team Tournament (the Darkside's Wolf & Reaper defeat the tournament's Asylum & Bloodhound entry), none of which are titled matches. Maverick closes the show cutting a promo daring Bloodhound to interfere in a coming match. Two named wrestlers who appear only in this card's own opening and debut matches (Buddah Lova, Westside Gangsta, Psycothic) are not independently minted here.

name: EHWA: Rockingham Speedway Card, 12 March 1997

date.source: The document's own dateline, billing itself "the most recent card" from "the Rockingham Speedway here in Rockingham, North Carolina."

matches.finish: Hades defeats Psychotic after a chair shot and a second Satan's Sign finisher.

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
matches.finish: Justin Blaze retains the Extreme Television Championship, forcing X-Pert to submit to the Silencer; no title-change document survives placing the belt on Blaze between Viglen's 4 March win and this card.

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-internet
matches.finish: Playboy Ronnie D. defeats Warlord Chaos to win the Extreme Internet Championship; the surviving text does not identify who held the title going in.

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-tag
matches.finish: Eclipse & Cataclysm retain the World Tag Team Championship over the Powers of Destruction (Pain & Agony) on a restart after the referee is knocked out and the French Canadians (Martin & Jean) interfere with a brick; no title-change document survives placing the belt on Eclipse & Cataclysm between the Knights' 4 March defense and this card.

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-world
matches.finish: Ivan Thor Thunder retains the Extreme World Championship over Asylum with his Thunderstrike finisher; Hades attacks the beaten Asylum afterward, drawing a chase from Asylum's own corner.

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-tv
matches.finish: Justin Blaze is disqualified after X-Pert interferes on his behalf against Bloodhound; the title does not change hands on a disqualification. Blaze closes the show booking a three-way with Bloodhound and X-Pert.

notes: Also carries a debut/return match (Buddah Lova and the newcomer Psycothic's earlier bout is not repeated here; this card opens fresh with Hades vs Psychotic), a double count-out (Red Panther vs Bloodhound, broken up by an angle between the X-Pert and Justin Blaze factions), a three-way tag elimination tournament match (the Buff Brothers, Flex & Pump, defeat the Killer Aliens and the Warlords in sequence to earn a future Internet Tag Team Championship shot), a squash (Sexy Stallion defeats Viglen), and a squash (Alex Gowan defeats Flash Killerman). The Extreme World Championship match's own billing ("the Extreme World Title") is the same top belt the 25 February card calls Ivan Thor Thunder's "Internet championship"; read as one continuously-held title named inconsistently by the federation's own single author, not a second, undocumented title change -- see the wing's own provenance note.

name: EHWA: Ultimate Survivor Battle Royal, 30 November 1997

matches.title: ehwa-entity-a-us
matches.stipulation: 16-man Ultimate Survivor Battle Royal for the newly created US Title, the vacant Extreme Internet Championship, and a future Extreme World Championship match
matches.finish: "Too Sexy" Christopher Charles outlasts the field, last eliminating Alex Gowan, to win the US Title and the vacant Extreme Internet Championship (vacated earlier in the night when Slade Kane quit the federation) in the same match.

no_appearances_reason: Only the winner and the two wrestlers with existing tenures elsewhere (Red Panther, Alex Gowan) are individually credited; the remaining entrants appear only as this battle royal's own eliminations, per the standing one-show-jobber practice, and are not independently minted.
notes: The battle royal's own closing line has Charles "holding up all three of his titles" though the card names only two (the US Title and the Internet Championship, plus a future World Championship shot, which is not itself a title); the third title is not identified and this inconsistency is not resolved.
